content.value: A majority gate is a digital circuit whose output is equal to 1 if the majority of the inputs (10) [CO2 are 1's. The outputs are 0 otherwise. By means of a Truth Table, find the Boolean function implemented by a 3-input majority gate. Simplify the function.
